title: Strict structured output rejects the schema: 'required' must include every key in properties
symptoms: Invalid schema for response_format: In context=(), 'required' is required to be supplied and to be an array including every key in properties.
400 invalid_json_schema for a Pydantic model with an optional or dict field
Zod discriminated union at the root is rejected
cause: With strict set to true every property must be listed in required, every object needs additionalProperties false, and the root must be a plain object, not anyOf. Optional fields and open maps break those rules.
fix: Make optional fields required but nullable, replace free form dicts with arrays of key and value objects, and wrap unions inside a root object.
affected: OpenAI Structured Outputs with strict true, Responses and Chat Completions, checked October 2026
